column2: WARNING Transformer Radiator Fins Sign – Radiator Is Not A Lift Point – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Radiator Is Not A Lift Point. This WARNING Transformer Radiator Fins sign from CGAP Safety reads: TRANSFORMER RADIATOR FINS / RADIATOR IS NOT A LIFT POINT / LIFT ATTACHMENT CAN TEAR FREE / USE DESIGNATED LIFTING POINTS. Written for electric utility substations, power generation plants, transformer yards.

Why this sign matters

Radiator fins are thin and not designed to carry a lifting load. A lift attachment can tear free and drop the transformer or part.

Where to post it

Mount on the transformer tank wall beside the radiator bank.

Who orders it

Substation maintenance supervisor, utility rigger.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.184; OSHA 1910.269; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
